import pandas as pd

sheets = pd.read_excel('sales_data.xlsx', sheet_name=None, header=None)
for name, df in sheets.items():
    print(f"Sheet: {name}, shape: {df.shape}")
    print(df.head(10).to_string())

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

with zipfile.ZipFile('sales_data.xlsx') as z:
    print("=== styles.xml ===")
    print(z.read('xl/styles.xml').decode('utf-8'))
    print()
    print("=== sheet1.xml (full) ===")
    print(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml').decode('utf-8'))

import zipfile
import shutil

SRC = 'sales_data.xlsx'
TMP = 'sales_data_tmp.xlsx'

def read(z, n):
    return z.read(n)

with zipfile.ZipFile(SRC) as zin, zipfile.ZipFile(TMP, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zout:
    for item in zin.infolist():
        data = zin.read(item.filename)
        if item.filename == 'xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml':
            s = data.decode('utf-8')
            # dimension + column width
            s = s.replace('dimension ref="A1:G10"', 'dimension ref="A1:H10"')
            s = s.replace(
                '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/></cols>',
                '<col width="12" customWidth="1" min="7" max="7"/><col width="12" customWidth="1" min="8" max="8"/></cols>'
            )
            # header
            s = s.replace(
                '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c>',
                '<c r="G1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit</t></is></c><c r="H1" s="1" t="inlineStr"><is><t>Profit Margin</t></is></c>'
            )
            # data rows 2..9
            for r in range(2, 10):
                old = f'<c r="G{r}"><f>E{r}-C{r}*F{r}</f><v></v></c></row>'
                new = old.replace('</c></row>', f'</c><c r="H{r}" s="3"><f>G{r}/E{r}</f></c></row>')
                assert old in s, f"pattern missing row {r}"
                s = s.replace(old, new)
            # total row 10
            old10 = '<c r="G10"><f>SUM(G2:G9)</f><v></v></c></row>'
            new10 = old10.replace('</c></row>', '</c><c r="H10" s="4"><f>G10/E10</f></c></row>')
            assert old10 in s
            s = s.replace(old10, new10)
            data = s.encode('utf-8')
        elif item.filename == 'xl/styles.xml':
            s = data.decode('utf-8')
            assert '<numFmts count="0"/>' in s
            s = s.replace(
                '<numFmts count="0"/>',
                '<numFmts count="1"><numFmt numFmtId="164" formatCode="0.0%;-0.0%;-"/></numFmts>'
            )
            assert 'cellXfs count="3"' in s
            s = s.replace('cellXfs count="3"', 'cellXfs count="5"')
            s = s.replace(
                '</cellXfs>',
                '<xf numFmtId="164" fontId="0" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/>'
                '<xf numFmtId="164" fontId="1" fillId="0" borderId="0" pivotButton="0" quotePrefix="0" xfId="0"/></cellXfs>'
            )
            data = s.encode('utf-8')
        zout.writestr(item, data)

shutil.move(TMP, SRC)
print("done")
